dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sassy Sessie is at risk due to her behavioral and medical concerns. Sassy Sessie was involved in a dog fight with resident dog. Owner was bitten on their finger resulting in 3 stitches when they broke up the dog fight in the home. In the care center, she is noted to lean into petting, show social behavior, and with a loose body and wagging tail. Medically, Sassy Sessie has CIRDC and is also in late stages of a pregnancy.

Sassy arrived at MACC following a bite incident in the home. Sassy was in the living room with the resident dogs when she began to growl and lunge before biting the dog on the ear. When the owner went to intervene, Sassy bit them on the finger. While in care, Sassy has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to bark and growl at handlers when they approach her in kennel. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an experienced adult-only, single pet home that makes no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Sassy Sessie
